reviews.text: Today for the first time I brought my 4 and a half month old Golden Retriever puppy, they were very kind and qualified.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Super kind and helpful, attentive to every detail, and above all, truly capable! I have seven pitbulls, and they've managed to handle them perfectly, with patience, kindness, and great professionalism. You can see the love they put into their work and the care they dedicate to the animals. I'm so happy I trusted them, highly recommended! 🐾❤️
Chiara is very good, professional, precise and kind... I recommend her makeup to everyone!

I took my Tommy, who has a somewhat difficult personality, to Canito for the first time and was truly impressed not only by Chiara's professionalism, but also by the attention, patience, and sensitivity she showed him. You could tell she loved animals right away. The end result was completely satisfying, and Tommy, besides being very cute, went away calm and wagging his tail... Highly recommended! ❤️

Just one word... PERFECT.
I RECOMMEND BOTH FOR HIS PROFESSIONALISM AND HIS PERSONAL FRIENDLINESS.

We were very pleased with Chiara; she's very welcoming and affectionate with furry friends. Our IPA had a great time, and it was her first bath. Now she's fresher and more beautiful thanks to Chiara. We'll be back in a month for her first haircut. Thanks again!!!!

Today, Poldo, a 4-month-old puppy, got his first bath. I went to Chiara without knowing her. My little one had a great time, and I even more so. She knows her job and has been unique with our furry friends since the first meeting. Thank you so much ♥️ Chiara
Courtesy and professionalism, and, above all, love for dogs and cats
I've been taking my furry friend Bobo to Chiara for two years now, and I'm so happy with her. Chiara is kind, friendly, and professional; you can tell she's passionate about her work.
Attentive and scrupulous staff with the furry ones
My dogs came out beautiful, smelling good, and most of all happy. I'll always come back here and recommend it to everyone!

Chiara is truly professional and lovely!
Every time I bring my dog ​​to her, I feel safe; you can tell she's passionate about her work!
I highly recommend her!

I trusted Chiara to groom my Maltese.
I found her very professional and patient with my dog.
I highly recommend her!

I took my dog ​​to Canito Toeletta for the first time and was impressed by Chiara's attention to detail and professionalism. You can feel her love for animals. I really appreciated how Chiara reassured Moka to put her at ease before the treatment. The environment was also clean and tidy. I highly recommend it!

I brought my puppy here for the first time and had a wonderful experience. Chiara is a very kind person who cares about the animals' well-being above all else. I'm happy to have trusted such a professional. Highly recommended!
We're completely satisfied with our puppy's first grooming! At Canito, we found the service to be professional, kind, helpful, and clean. Thank you so much for the wonderful job you did on my puppy!

We trusted Chiara with the grooming of our long-haired cat and were very satisfied! Chiara proved to be very professional: she first suggested a trial to assess the cat's reaction, and only then did we schedule the appointment. Once home, the cat was calm and not at all stressed, finally clean and without a single tangle! Chiara took care of everything, paws, ears, hygienic cuts, and everything else... We'll definitely be back.
Today I took Balu' for the first time, I had a great time, Chiara is a very sweet person and you can feel the love she has for these "babies".
Our trusted grooming salon. Professionalism and expertise. Thank you, Chiara.

It was my first time taking my dog ​​to this groomer, and I had a great time. The staff was kind and patient, and very attentive to the animals' well-being. My dog ​​left feeling clean, smelling good, and happy.
I'll definitely be back, highly recommended!

This is the second time I've brought my Maltese to this facility. It's a truly professional place, very attentive to the dog's cleanliness. The grooming is perfect, meticulous in every detail. The girls are very nice and very good.

My neighbors recommended I take our Lillo to Via Pietro Marchisio for a grooming. I trusted them, without looking for too much information, because their dog was really well cared for…
And I must say, the same confidence I felt when I first came in is the same confidence I feel every time I return!
Highly recommended!

Thank you for your experience at Canitotoeletta.
If you have any advice or suggestions, we'd love to hear them.
😊🐕🐱 …

I've known Chiara since February 2025, after I moved to the area. I'd read excellent reviews and immediately trusted her. I don't think I've made a better choice. She's incredibly sweet, patient with my toy poodle Destiny, professional, and available to accommodate my four-legged daughter's every need.
There's nothing more beautiful than seeing Destiny happy and happy to come and get her beauty treatment.
Thank you for all the love and professionalism you show her.
I wouldn't trade you for any other groomer in the world 💜

There's no other groomer I'd trust with my puppies! Chiara is simply extraordinary: patient, sweet, and incredibly professional. She's been caring for my two corgis for years, and even though one of them isn't particularly fond of baths or nail clippings, she always manages to put him at ease and do an impeccable job.
I also really appreciate her availability: my work often leaves me little room for organization, but Chiara is always ready to find a solution to accommodate my schedule. A true guarantee of love and expertise. Highly recommended!
A well-deserved 5 stars. Patient, kind, and helpful. We've toured several in the area, and I have to say, in my opinion, this is the best! 🥰 …

We brought our dogs for the first time.
Little Hercules, very lively and short-haired. He usually refuses to be bathed and bites anyone he doesn't know.
Apple, a cross between a Maremma Sheepdog and a Golden Retriever, has very long fur, unfortunately with knots and abundant undergrowth.
As soon as they arrived, they were greeted with cuddles and caresses, which made them feel at ease.
We picked them up spotless, smelling good, and happy to be there.
It has become our trusted dog groomer.
Not only for the fair prices, but for the care and love with which they treat their furry friends.
Highly recommended!

I can only confirm the 5 stars! I had heard about them, but since I don't live in the area, I couldn't use their services! I took my long-haired Chihuahua to them and I only had confirmation, Lola was beautiful 💖. Plus, the kindness and professionalism of the staff makes the difference. Thank you so much. …

Professional and patient
Excellent service, I recommend it

My mother-in-law has a Maltese, and when she's visiting us in Rome, we've taken her to this place, so full of love and professionalism for four-legged friends. This is the only way to explain the owner's infinite kindness, patience, and sweetness, not only with animals but also with people. A highly recommended groomer...Thanks, Chiara!

I'm happy to have made your experience and that of your four-legged friend enjoyable.
Thank you 🙏 …

We took our Lello to Canito about a week ago.
It was truly an emergency because the little monster had rolled around in a place he shouldn't have.
They accommodated our request very quickly.
The lady was truly kind and, above all, attentive with the reminder, which I think is invaluable; sometimes, with so many commitments, you can forget.
We recommended being gentle with Lello's eyes because he had just finished a major treatment. The staff were super attentive and gentle.
The drying was impeccable!
Unfortunately, we had a previous experience that didn't satisfy us, leaving us unsure about Lello's future baths.
Canito completely satisfied both dog and owner.
Finally, a point of reference for our dog's hygiene!
A big thank you to the staff at Canito.
I highly recommend it. We'll be back soon! 🐾

Thank you so much, Giulio!
I'm glad I made your experience pleasant and satisfying 🙏
 …

Simply a fantastic experience!
I brought my Lagotto today. He's a rather reserved and very fearful dog. I was nervous since it was his first time. He was treated with great professionalism, taking his time. Not only is he beautiful, but he remained calm throughout the entire grooming session! You are wonderful!
Always great service
Friendly and professional, I brought my 2 poodles for a complete grooming, I am very satisfied with the result, I recommend

Excellent!
My puppy Birba had her hair stripped yesterday. Now she's beautiful and soft. The operators were very good at it, and despite the complexity of the operation, they managed not to stress my dog!
I brought my puppy for the first time after trying others over the years.. I can say that I am 100% satisfied, excellent work, good girls, I recommend it 🤩🤩❤️ …

I had a truly exceptional experience at this groomer. The staff was incredibly calm, patient, and professional in handling my one-year-old Malinois, who isn't easy to handle and isn't usually inclined to be groomed by strangers. I was impressed by their ability to put her at ease and take care of her without rushing her, ensuring impeccable results. I highly recommend this groomer. I'll definitely be back!

I took my dog ​​(a Bolognese breed) for a grooming session. The owner, who was super helpful, scheduled an appointment within two days. The price was excellent, and the dog came out looking better than I'd ever seen her after her bath: happy, smelling great, clean, and incredibly soft. I've already booked my next appointment. Highly recommended!

I tried taking my Pepe to Canito because when I picked him up from the groomer where I used to go, he was always nervous, almost scared. I've already entrusted him to Chiara twice, and he's calm when I pick him up, and he's perfectly washed and smells good. It's clear that there's a passion and a lot of love for our furry friends, which makes the grooming time, which isn't always a favorite for them, more enjoyable. Thank you.
Chiara is very good and patient. Excellent work on my kocher.
Highly recommended, truly professional and friendly.

I'm really super satisfied. The girl asked me to bring my dog ​​15 minutes before the appointment time so she could get to know her a little. She interacted with her, tried to reassure her and put her at ease before the grooming. I really like the care they take with their dogs and I appreciated the fact that they sent me a photo of the dog dressed up for Halloween. When I got home, her fur was super soft and she had been clipped beautifully 🥹🫶

Yesterday afternoon I took my Lagotto for a complete grooming which, due to various circumstances, I delayed too much. Anyone who knows this breed is aware of how quickly knots form in the undercoat, making grooming extremely complicated. …

Our friends feel right at home here.
Great empathy and professionalism.
Congratulations to Chiara.

A truly positive experience in welcoming a new customer..... my beloved Maltese Dudu' wonderfully arranged with the perfect cut and attention to every little detail to make me satisfied... very good Chiara... you have captured my trust and …

Five stars aren't enough! When I leave my furry friend, I feel at peace, and this is thanks to the trust Chiara has earned. Her love for her work, but especially for our furry friends, shines through. Her expertise, not just in grooming, …

What can I say... kindness, professionalism, patience, and empathy with our furry companions are the words I would use to describe Chiara and her entire business. Even though my dogs are very wary, they always manage to do an impeccable …

What can I say? I've known Chiara for three years. She's very kind and, above all, professional. The place is spotless. I have a Maltese and I bring him to her every month. I've never tried any grooming. Chiara is a guarantee. Highly recommended ❤️
